first_message_variable.name: opening_line
first_message_variable.note: ADR-254. Not in 'variables' because the prompt doesn't use it. The app sends opening_line with every conversation: the greeting after "Hey Doddy" ("Hey Pat, what's up?", WakeGreeting.line) or the usual opening ("Hey, it's Doddy. What's up?" / "Hej, tu Doddy. Co słychać?", WakeGreeting.openingLine). On ElevenLabs the placeholder must be set as the agent's dynamic-variable placeholder for opening_line, so builds that don't send it still start. The placeholder is the live English first message as read on 2026-10-11 (the owner's dashboard text "Hey, it's Doddy. what's up?"; this file's older "What's on your mind?" had drifted). Applied to the live agent 2026-10-11 (owner: "you do it"): English and Polish first message {{opening_line}}, placeholder opening_line as above; the other 35 language presets and all placeholders unchanged. Versions agtvrsn_5701m4m4268zfx2s83k8xcdg5bgm (before) -> agtvrsn_2701m4mc8sejfzkbjmekv9nczdrp -> agtvrsn_6701m4mc9b7wekgb2jeg1c6pwnyv. Read again 2026-10-11 after later syncs (version agtvrsn_8201m4mf5fqhf9087wkrjz8kjenp): still {{opening_line}} for English and Polish with this placeholder.

variables.saved_notes_truncated: 'yes' when the list was cut short, else 'no'
variables.doddy_personality: Style settings from Settings, Doddy's personality (PersonalityPrompt.render); default = Doddy's default
variables.learned_context: What Doddy learned and the user confirmed (LearningPrompt.render, ADR-440): facts and saved routines, sent only when Settings, What I've learned, 'Use what Doddy learned in voice conversations' is on; otherwise the not-shared line. Not sent in translator mode.
variables.user_profile: Approved introduction answers (ProfilePrompt.render), sent only when Settings, About you, 'Use in voice conversations' is on; otherwise the not-shared line
variables.saved_lists: List names with open and ticked counts (ListsPrompt.render, ADR-216), no items; the not-shared line when opened from Home, Translate
variables.translator_start: 'none', or translator mode when the conversation was opened from Home, Translate (TranslatorPrompt.render, ADR-215); then saved_notes, recent_conversations and user_profile carry a not-shared line instead
variables.morning_checkin: 'none', or the morning check-in's facts (today's Doddy reminders, lists with things left) after the user tapped Talk it through (MorningCheckInPrompt.render, ADR-220)

soft_timeout.note: A short, language-neutral hum when the model has not started speaking after 2 s (SPEED_AND_RESPONSIVENESS.md 1.4). Static on purpose: a filler never claims anything was done.

elevenlabs.language_presets: One preset per non-English language in 'languages', each overriding only the first message (ADR-212). The built-in language_detection tool (only_at_conversation_start false) switches between them at any point in a conversation.

client_overrides.note: Settings, Voice and personality (VoiceStyle, ADR-105); only changed values are sent

elevenlabs.variables_as: dynamic_variables (filled by the app at startConversation)
elevenlabs.placeholders_note: The live agent's dynamic-variable placeholders, read 2026-10-11 (version agtvrsn_8701m4nqkm9sezbaqxeyddwrey89). They are used when an app build doesn't send a variable. The API replaces the whole set at once, so keep all of them when applying. recent_conversations is no longer in the prompt (prompt diet, 2026-10-12, owner-approved) and so not in 'variables', but app builds still send it, so its placeholder stays. Stopping the app from sending it is an app change (VoiceSessionController), not done yet.

placeholders.learned_context: (The user has not switched on using what Doddy learned in voice conversations.)
placeholders.doddy_personality:
The user chose these settings in the app:
- Humour: subtle. At most one small dry remark about everyday hassles, and only when the moment is light.
- Reply length: brief. One or two sentences unless the user asks for more.
- Tone: casual, like a friendly mate. Informal words are fine (in Polish use "ty").
- Energy: grounded. Relaxed and steady, with a little warmth when something goes well.
These are style preferences only. Whatever they say: answer the question first, stay honest about being an AI, follow the memory and tool rules exactly, never joke about anything serious (health, money, legal, grief, distress), and never use sarcasm at the user, guilt, flattery or clinginess.
placeholders.recent_conversations: (The app did not send any earlier conversations.)
placeholders.saved_lists: (The app did not send any lists for this conversation.)
placeholders.saved_notes: (The app did not send any saved notes for this conversation.)
placeholders.user_profile: (The user has not shared their introduction answers with voice conversations.)

openai_realtime.status: built for testing behind Home's voice switch (ADR-265): OpenAIRealtimeWire (DoddyCore) and OpenAIRealtimeSession (app); not yet heard on a device

session_update.instructions: voice-agent/instructions.md with {{variables}} filled in by the app (RealtimeInstructions.render)

output.voice: set by the token server (OPENAI_REALTIME_VOICE, default marin); the app does not change it

openai_realtime.web_tools: OpenAI sends every function call to the client. Tools with runs_on 'web' (place lookup, weather, Wikipedia) are not executed in the ADR-265 test: the app answers them as unavailable so Doddy says so. Running them would mean the app or the token server making those requests (x_doddy.http).
openai_realtime.auth: Server mints a short-lived client secret; the API key never ships in the app (ADR-034).
